The corridor includes loops and spurs rather than one linear drive. Moment order follows Rochelle toward Cross Creek, then the McIntosh-to-Micanopy leg in increasing strip miles and north to Paynes Prairie. Cross Creek and Paynes Prairie have no strip-mile entries.
Rawlings arrival in 1928 is supported by FDOT and Cross Creek; the house article dates the property purchase to 1929. Avoided assigning an acquisition year.
Omitted the current invitation to pick oranges: only a secondary cache source supports it, with no park-manager confirmation of current permission.
